Reliance Explores Satellite Partnerships to Counter Starlink

Reliance Industries is reportedly exploring manufacturing partnerships with Indian firms and satellite imports from the US to build its planned 1,600-satellite broadband constellation. This move is aimed at expanding connectivity and strengthening India's strategic space capabilities, positioning Reliance to counter Elon Musk's Starlink service.
